4. Free Access and Subscriptions

Free access

Each free Gameday account includes 25 AI voice generations in total; they do not refresh. Other feature or content limits may apply as displayed in the app, such as access to the full Gameday Tracks catalog and personal MP3 import. Promotional allowances may be offered separately. Previously purchased or legally required rights will not be removed retroactively.

Paid subscriptions

Gameday may offer monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions. The exact subscription name, duration, included features, trial terms, and localized price are displayed before you confirm a purchase.

Voice-generation allowance

Each successful Generate or Regenerate request uses one generation from your allowance. Your allowance depends on your plan:

  • Free: 25 generations in total.
  • Monthly subscription: 100 generations in each monthly billing period.
  • Annual subscription: 1,200 generations in each annual billing period.

Unused generations expire at the end of each billing period and do not roll over. The app shows how many generations remain.

Some requests don't use your allowance:

  • Fixes. Regenerating a player's introduction or an announcement that already has a recording, for example after correcting a name or number, is free, up to 5 times per player or announcement and up to a quarter of your allowance in each period.
  • Repeats. If the same text in the same voice has been generated before, Gameday may return the saved recording at no charge.
  • Playback. Playing, previewing, or replaying an existing recording never uses a generation.

Each request is limited to 120 characters for a player introduction and 200 characters for an announcement, and to 30 requests per hour. When an allowance is used up, new requests are unavailable until the next billing period unless you change plans. Existing recordings can still be played. We may correct balances affected by fraud, account sharing, refunds, chargebacks, or technical errors.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled before the end of the current subscription period in accordance with Apple's subscription rules. Your Apple Account may be charged for renewal shortly before the current period ends.

You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account subscription settings. Deleting the app or your Gameday account does not automatically cancel an App Store subscription. You may use Restore Purchases in Gameday to restore eligible purchases associated with your Apple Account.

Apple handles billing, taxes collected through the App Store, refunds, billing retry, and payment disputes under Apple's terms and applicable law. Prices and availability may vary by country or storefront. Any free trial converts to a paid subscription unless canceled before the trial ends as disclosed at the time of purchase.

5. Voice Generation and Generated Content

Gameday uses a third-party text-to-speech provider to create synthetic audio when you intentionally tap Generate or Regenerate. You authorize us and our service providers to process the submitted text and selected voice for that purpose.

To avoid generating the same audio twice, Gameday keeps a saved copy of each generated recording, identified only by a fingerprint of its text and voice, and may return it to anyone who requests exactly the same text and voice.

Synthetic audio may mispronounce words, names, or numbers, produce unexpected results, or fail. You are responsible for reviewing generated audio before using it at an event. Do not use generated content to impersonate a real person, mislead others, harass anyone, violate publicity or privacy rights, or create unlawful, hateful, defamatory, or abusive material.

Subject to these Terms and any applicable third-party restrictions, Gameday grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to play voice recordings generated for your account through the Service. Gameday may keep generated voice files within the app and your private cloud storage without offering an export or standalone download feature.

7. Coaches, Families, and Team Invites

A coach can invite families to a team using a team code or QR code. A family member who joins chooses which player they manage and picks that player's walkout songs; the coach manages the team, roster, batting order, and player introductions.

  • Coaches. Inviting families requires an active paid Gameday plan. You choose whether families may pick songs with explicit content. You are responsible for sharing your team code only with the families of your players, and you may turn the code off, replace it, or remove a family from your team at any time. A family's songs play on your device as part of your team's audio; you remain responsible for playing audio appropriate to your event and venue.
  • Families. You must be the player's parent or legal guardian, or have their permission, to manage the player's profile. You may manage only the player you are connected to, and you are responsible for the songs you choose. Your song list belongs to your account and stays with you if the player moves to another team; joining a new team requires that team's code.
  • Songs. Family song lists may include Gameday-provided tracks, which are available to families of a team whose coach has an active paid plan, subject to Section 9. Personal MP3s can't be added to a family song list.

If the coach's paid plan ends, families keep their profiles and song lists, but new families can't join the team until the plan is active again.

You are solely responsible for having all rights and permissions needed to possess and publicly or privately play imported music. Gameday does not grant rights to music you import. You may not use Gameday to infringe copyright, circumvent digital-rights controls, or distribute unauthorized copies.

Personal files may become unavailable if they are moved, renamed, deleted, removed from the device, or no longer accessible through the selected file provider. You are responsible for maintaining your own lawful source files and backups.
